searchText: Sharing the actual response: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/25493#issuecomment-1207986241 > We've known about this vector for a bit (possibly from the authors). Fixing it in a simple way may or may not introduce additional unforeseen issues. Given that we're in the final stretch for replacing PoW with PoS, we've felt it't not worth risking a fix for a marginal gain for a marginal time span. I wonder if this counts as the first validator led attack on eth since he’s bigger on PoS than pow and beaconchain is active now 😂😂 Im starting to think one of the best benefits post-merge, possibly on par with not destroying our environment for greed, is not having to read through chs2's and some miners' daily gaslighting on these forums 😂 I’ll still be around we run some non pow pool eth stuff and dapps just like bitfly plus I personally have eth 😂 also there may or may not be a large Canadian pos pool we may or may not be involved with. Eth is Canadian central. Yes. That’s about rejecting the single block reorganizations What’s up with my latest messages in this channel? This is getting very annoying, I get attacked by random people because I try to fix something we all use. Then I also haven’t received any single message here from the Geth team, you think I deserved that? Can you just stop going off topic and discuss how “bad” I am? I’m sure this channel was not created for this. I expected to get technical response to my technical question, not what you all started here I’m here to talk to actual developers about actual problems, not about discussing who is “bad” and who is not. Guys it's becoming increasingly hard to find any content in these channels. Can we at least pretend to be on-topic? Or move to <#595721451651465227> which is anyway out of control 💯💯💯 I totally agree with <@755590043632140352> If mods can delete all messages from https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/688075293562503241/1006192785457696898, that would be great.
